title: 黑部水壩~Kurobe Dam
focus: 高山拱壩承載與高水頭水能系統~Mountain arch action and high head energy systems
summary: 由黑部峽谷的拱壩背景出發，把融雪集水、岩盤承載、混凝土溫度、輸水損失與下游流量變化連成同一個守恆問題。學員比較靜水、穩流及瞬變三種時間尺度，辨識簡化模型所能回答的問題。所有參數為分開標明的假想教材，不能當成實際設備設定。~Starting from the Kurobe mountain setting, this course connects snowmelt collection, rock support, concrete temperature, conduit losses and downstream flow changes through conservation and compatibility. Learners distinguish static, steady and transient time scales and identify what each reduced model can actually answer. Every numerical parameter is separately identified as hypothetical teaching data rather than an equipment setting.
history: 關西電力歷史頁記載黑四工程於一九六三年竣工，黑部水壩高一百八十六公尺，並記述施工隧道遭遇大量地下水的困難。這些是案例背景，不代表本課能重建原設計。教材以拱的推力與岩盤變形為主線，再延伸至水能、瞬變與監測；參考的美國工兵團一九九四年拱壩手冊僅核對官方目錄與封面年代。與翡翠的並列是教學比較，不表示兩壩的施工、材料或法規相同。~KEPCO records Kuroyon completion in 1963, a dam height of 186 m and difficult groundwater encountered during tunnel construction. These facts establish context and do not reconstruct the original design. The curriculum follows arch thrust and rock deformation before extending to energy, transients and monitoring. The USACE 1994 arch reference was checked at catalogue and cover scope. Comparison with Feitsui is educational and implies no equivalence of construction, materials or governing requirements.
example: 假想融雪流入為每秒二十立方公尺、放流每秒十二立方公尺，六小時內增加十七萬二千八百立方公尺蓄量；這只是水量帳，尚未求出水位。另一假想拱圈以壓力零點八兆帕、半徑一百二十公尺、厚度十公尺求得平均膜壓應力九點六兆帕，不能取代三維壩體分析。把厚度增加百分之二十至十二公尺，應力降至八兆帕；比較結果時仍需考慮岩盤變形與溫度拘束。 核驗：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。~For an assumed snowmelt inflow of 20 m3/s and release of 12 m3/s, six hours adds 172800 m3 of storage; a storage curve is still needed to infer water level. A separate ideal arch strip with pressure 0.8 MPa, radius 120 m and thickness 10 m has mean membrane compression of 9.6 MPa. Increasing thickness by twenty percent to 12 m gives 8 MPa. This sensitivity does not replace three dimensional dam analysis, because foundation movement, bending and thermal restraint remain outside the strip model. Verification: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.

units.anchor: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳~Snowmelt pulses and storage
units.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳~Snowmelt pulses and storage
units.mechanism: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。 融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。~Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change. Snow water equivalent and temporary soil storage also control melt runoff. Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied.
units.verify: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。~Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.
units.failure: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。~Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks.
units.misconception: 蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升~Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion
units.practice: 將入流峰值改成前兩小時三十、後四小時十五立方公尺每秒，分段求蓄量並與平均法比較，說明兩者何時相同、何時因出口變化而不同。~Replace constant inflow with thirty cubic metres per second for two hours and fifteen for four hours. Integrate segments and explain when averaging preserves volume and when a varying outlet invalidates the comparison.

units.anchor: 理想拱圈膜壓應力~Ideal arch membrane compression
units.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力~Ideal arch membrane compression
units.mechanism: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。把一條水平窄帶理想化為等厚圓環，只保留膜作用，可從局部力平衡看見半徑與厚度如何改變平均壓應力；實際雙曲率壩仍有懸臂及彎曲。 薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。~Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects. Pressure times radius is circumferential force per unit height; division by thickness converts it to mean stress. Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded.
units.verify: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。再改變厚度與曲率而保持水壓不變，確認所得應力趨勢合理，並列出必須由三維模型補回的支承條件。~Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Change thickness and radius separately at fixed pressure, check the trends and identify support conditions that must return in a three-dimensional model.
units.failure: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。~Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A low average cannot establish that local tensile cracking is absent.
units.misconception: 只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計~Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
units.practice: 保持水壓與半徑不變，將厚度增加到十二公尺後重算，畫出厚度與應力的反比曲線，並說明為何材料用量與整體變形不會只由此曲線決定。~Increase thickness to twelve metres at fixed pressure and radius, recalculate and plot the inverse relationship. Explain why this curve alone cannot determine material quantity, foundation response or the complete deformation field.

units.anchor: 岩盤順應與推力位移~Abutment compliance under thrust
units.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移~Abutment compliance under thrust
units.mechanism: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。 同一模數配上不同受力面積或岩盤有效深度，會形成不同支承剛度，因而需要先說明彈簧代表的幾何尺度。~Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample. The same modulus combined with different loaded areas or effective rock depths produces different support stiffnesses. The equivalent spring therefore needs a declared geometric scale before its displacement has physical meaning.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。適用邊界：單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Applicable boundary: One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property.
units.verify: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。使用載入與卸載兩段斜率比較等效剛度，若回程無法閉合，應另外檢查節理滑移與儀器基座變動。~Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Estimate stiffness from both loading and unloading slopes. If the loop does not close, investigate joint slip and movement of the instrument base separately.
units.failure: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。~An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. Attributing every observed displacement to weak rock is equally misleading because thermal expansion and reference drift can create reversible changes.
units.misconception: 岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度~Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
units.practice: 另設左岸剛度為一萬二千兆牛頓每公尺，在相同反力下比較兩岸位移，討論差異位移可能如何改變拱圈變形，並指出仍缺少哪些三維平衡條件。~Assign the left support a stiffness of twelve thousand meganewtons per metre and compare movements under equal reactions. Discuss possible arch distortion and identify the missing equilibrium conditions needed before predicting redistribution.

units.anchor: 混凝土受拘束溫降~Restrained concrete cooling
units.title: 混凝土受拘束溫降~Restrained concrete cooling
units.mechanism: 混凝土冷卻本來會縮短，但岩盤或相鄰塊體若限制收縮，就可能產生拉應力。高山環境的季節溫度與壩內溫度不會同步，完全拘束模型只能用來辨識熱應變的量級，不能忽略徐變及接縫開合。 熱應變本身沒有力的單位，只有與彈性模數及拘束條件結合才形成應力；自由收縮與完全拘束提供兩個理想端點。~Cooling concrete tends to contract, while restraint by rock or adjoining blocks can create tension. Mountain air and internal concrete temperatures respond on different schedules, so full restraint indicates a thermal strain scale without representing creep or joint opening. Thermal strain has no force unit. Stress emerges only when stiffness and restraint are supplied, making free contraction and full restraint distinct ideal endpoints for interpreting a temperature change.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa。適用邊界：完全軸向拘束、線彈性且忽略徐變；正值表示冷卻所致拉應力量級。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Full axial restraint, linear elasticity and no creep; the positive value is the tensile stress scale from cooling.
units.verify: 比較表面與內部溫度計的相位差，先決定哪個溫度代表受拘束體積。另以自由試件量得熱膨脹係數，核對應變計零點與季節基準，避免把儀器自身溫漂誤當混凝土拉伸。~Compare phase lag between surface and internal thermometers before selecting a representative restrained-volume temperature. Measure thermal expansion on an unrestrained specimen and check strain-gauge zero and seasonal reference so instrument temperature drift is not mistaken for concrete tension.
units.failure: 直接以每日氣溫降幅代替整塊混凝土溫降，通常誇大深部瞬時應力；若忽略長期徐變的鬆弛，也可能把彈性上限誤讀成持續存在的實際應力。~Using daily air cooling as the temperature change of an entire block exaggerates immediate interior response. Ignoring long-term creep relaxation can also turn an elastic bound into an incorrect estimate of sustained stress.
units.misconception: 每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變~Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
units.practice: 把拘束比例改為零點四並重算拉應力量級，另畫自由收縮與完全拘束兩個極端，說明實際接縫開合與徐變會如何移動答案的位置。~Recalculate with a restraint fraction of zero point four and sketch free contraction and full restraint as limiting cases. Explain how joint opening and creep can move the actual response between or beyond those simple bounds.

units.anchor: 長引水管的沿程損失~Friction in a long conduit
units.title: 長引水管的沿程損失~Friction in a long conduit
units.mechanism: 高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。達西摩擦式將長徑比與速度平方連結，黑部背景下可用來比較增大管徑與增加流量的代價，但粗糙度與局部損失仍需另計。 能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。~Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy. Darcy friction connects length-to-diameter ratio with velocity squared, allowing comparison of diameter and discharge choices while roughness and local losses remain separate inputs. The energy line falls along the conduit, while the pressure line also depends on elevation and velocity. Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m。適用邊界：滿管穩流且使用達西摩擦因子，不是范寧因子；未計彎頭與入口。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: f=0.018; L=1600 m; D=3 m; v=4 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f(L/D)v2/(2g)=7.82875 m. Applicable boundary: Steady full-pipe flow using the Darcy friction factor, not the Fanning factor; bends and entrance losses are excluded.
units.verify: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。選取穩定流量時段擬合摩擦因子，再檢查不同流量是否維持合理趨勢，避免把閥件損失全塞入沿程係數。~Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Fit the friction factor during steady periods and examine its trend across flows rather than absorbing every valve loss into distributed friction.
units.failure: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。~Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment.
units.misconception: 沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例~Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity
units.practice: 保持管徑與粗糙度不變，把速度提高百分之二十，重算水頭損失及增加比例，再列出摩擦因子可能隨雷諾數改變而使簡化比較失準的情況。~Raise velocity by twenty percent at fixed diameter and roughness, recalculate head loss and its percentage increase, then identify circumstances where a changing Reynolds number alters the friction factor and weakens the simple comparison.

units.anchor: 高水頭水能轉換~High head energy conversion
units.title: 高水頭水能轉換~High head energy conversion
units.mechanism: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。黑部案例應先把水路損失從毛水頭扣掉，再談電功率，否則同一耗能會被遺漏或重複扣除。 控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。~Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included. The conversion boundary must identify whether generator, transformer and auxiliary consumption are included. Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW。適用邊界：穩定水頭與流量，效率包含假想機電轉換但不含已扣除的水路損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW. Applicable boundary: Constant head and discharge; assumed electromechanical efficiency excludes waterway losses already removed from net head.
units.verify: 分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。若估算效率超過一，先查毛淨水頭混淆及千瓦兆瓦換算，再比較壓力與流量儀表的校正紀錄。~Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. An efficiency above unity requires checking gross versus net head and power-unit conversions before investigating calibration of pressure and discharge instruments.
units.failure: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。~Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. An efficiency that already includes waterway losses, followed by another friction deduction, counts the same energy loss twice.
units.misconception: 機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時~Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
units.practice: 用六小時等功率運行求兆瓦小時，再把淨水頭降低十公尺重算差值，註明效率保持不變是敏感度假設，不是實際機組效率曲線。~Calculate megawatt-hours for six hours at constant output, then reduce net head by ten metres and compare energy. State explicitly that unchanged efficiency is a sensitivity assumption rather than a measured turbine performance curve.

units.anchor: 快速流速變化與水錘~Rapid velocity change and water hammer
units.title: 快速流速變化與水錘~Rapid velocity change and water hammer
units.mechanism: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。焦科夫斯基關係給出理想快速變化的壓力尺度，與穩流摩擦屬不同物理過程，必須先比較變化時間與波的往返時間。 波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。~Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The Joukowsky relation gives an ideal rapid-change pressure scale, which differs from steady friction and requires comparison of change duration with the wave round-trip time. Wave speed reflects the combined compressibility of water and wall, not mean flow velocity. A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa。適用邊界：單相滿管、快速變化且不發生液柱分離；不是實際閥門操作指令。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa. Applicable boundary: Single-phase full-pipe rapid change without column separation; this is not an actual valve operating instruction.
units.verify: 以已知管長與波速估算壓力波往返時間，再確認壓力記錄取樣足以解析波峰。對照上下游波形的到達時間與反射極性，並檢查感測器量程是否把峰值截平而低估瞬變。~Estimate round-trip travel time from pipe length and wave speed, then confirm that pressure sampling resolves the peak. Compare arrival times and reflection signs at different locations and check whether sensor saturation clips the recorded maximum.
units.failure: 若局部壓力降到汽化條件，液柱分離及再結合可能改變峰值，簡單線性式不再完整；只把平均壓力加上算得增量也會忽略反射與高程分布。~If local pressure reaches vapor conditions, column separation and rejoining can alter peaks beyond the simple linear model. Adding one increment to an average pressure also neglects reflections and the elevation-dependent pressure distribution.
units.misconception: 一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力~One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location
units.practice: 在紙上比較波速七百與一千公尺每秒的壓力增量，說明管壁柔度如何影響結果，再列出需要瞬變模擬才能回答的反射與負壓問題。~Compare pressure increments for wave speeds of seven hundred and one thousand metres per second. Explain the role of wall flexibility and identify reflection and sub-atmospheric-pressure questions that require a transient model.

units.anchor: 施工湧水的抽排功率~Pumping energy for tunnel inflow
units.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率~Pumping energy for tunnel inflow
units.mechanism: 黑四施工歷史中的地下水困難提醒工程師，排水是水量、揚程與能源的聯合問題。假想隧道集水坑把來水提升到出口時，所需電功率須除以泵組效率；進水量估計不能只靠某一次乾天觀察。 總揚程包含出口與集水坑的位能差及流動損失，泵的工作點由供能曲線與管路需求曲線交會決定而非單看銘牌。~The historical groundwater difficulty highlights dewatering as a coupled flow, lift and energy problem. A hypothetical tunnel sump must lift inflow to an outlet, so electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump efficiency rather than multiplying by it. Total head contains elevation difference and flow losses. The operating point follows the intersection of pump supply and system demand curves, rather than being fixed by the nameplate flow alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW。適用邊界：穩定清水與總揚程，未計堵塞、含砂磨耗及備援需求，不是現場抽水計畫。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW. Applicable boundary: Steady clean-water flow and total head; blockage, abrasion and standby requirements are excluded, so this is not a site dewatering plan.
units.verify: 核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。以多個來水時段建立範圍，並檢查集水坑儲量變化，避免把坑內暫存水誤當穩定地下水補注。~Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge. Examine several inflow periods and sump storage changes so temporarily stored water is not mistaken for sustained groundwater recharge.
units.failure: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。~Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Abrasion or blockage can reduce efficiency, so rising electrical current may accompany falling water delivery and a continuing increase in sump level.
units.misconception: 抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率~Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
units.practice: 把效率降到零點五五，計算相同排水量所需輸入功率，再另列水位上升時總揚程改變的方向，說明不能只用電費判斷抽排能力。~Reduce efficiency to zero point five five and recalculate input power at the same flow. Separately determine how changing sump level alters head and explain why electricity consumption alone cannot demonstrate dewatering capacity.

units.anchor: 水位溫度與位移殘差~Level temperature and displacement residuals
units.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差~Level temperature and displacement residuals
units.mechanism: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。假想回歸模型先用水位及內部溫度預測位移，再看觀測殘差，但殘差只能提示進一步檢查，不能自行判定損傷。 係數描述既有資料中的統計關聯，不保證每一項都是獨立因果；水位與季節高度相關時，係數可變得難以辨識。~Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature. A hypothetical regression predicts movement from level and internal temperature before examining residuals, separating explanatory variables while leaving damage diagnosis to additional evidence and appropriate model validation. Coefficients describe associations in the calibration record rather than independent causal mechanisms. Strong correlation between reservoir level and season can make individual parameter estimates difficult to identify even when overall fit is good.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。適用邊界：線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. Applicable boundary: Coefficients are hypothetical calibrations restricted to the training range, with time lag omitted.
units.verify: 把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。對同時段的獨立儀器及基準點做交叉比對，若殘差突然跳變，先查換機、零點重設與缺值插補紀錄。~Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level. Cross-check independent instruments and references over matching periods, investigating replacement, zero resets and interpolation records before interpreting an abrupt residual jump.
units.failure: 以同一組資料擬合又驗證會掩蓋過度擬合；把未曾出現的高水位輸入線性模型，可能得到看似精確卻無外推根據的預測，延誤必要的人工判讀。~Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. Feeding an unprecedented high level into a linear model can produce a precise-looking prediction without extrapolation support and distract from the need for expert interpretation.
units.misconception: 監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全~A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety
units.practice: 加入一個一毫米的儀器零點偏移後重新求殘差，說明如何用鄰近儀器區分共同結構位移與單一測點故障，並列出不能只靠回歸辨識的因素。~Add a one-millimetre zero shift and recalculate the residual. Explain how nearby instruments could distinguish common structural movement from a single-point fault and identify causes that regression alone cannot resolve.

units.anchor: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量~Downstream buffer storage
units.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量~Downstream buffer storage
units.mechanism: 發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。假想緩衝池以暫時蓄水吸收入出流差額，所需容積由整個時段積分決定，不能只用最大流量相減而忽略持續時間與初始水位。 緩衝所需容積是累積差額曲線的最大與最小之差，若脈衝並非矩形，必須先積分完整歷線才能辨認容量需求。~Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery. A hypothetical buffer stores the time integral of the inlet-outlet difference; required volume depends on duration and initial storage, not merely the difference between two peak discharge values. For a repeating cycle, required active storage is the range of the cumulative imbalance curve. Nonrectangular pulses require integration of the complete hydrograph before the relevant volume can be identified.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。適用邊界：半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3. Applicable boundary: A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation.
units.verify: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。加入可用庫容上限時，要同時保留初始蓄量，不可從零開始假設。~Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them. Check whether subsequent flow differences restore the initial state, retaining initial storage explicitly when comparing against an available-volume limit.
units.failure: 緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。~Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. Checking a single pulse while ignoring the repeated cycle can falsely suggest that one fixed buffer volume will always accommodate the upstream release pattern.
units.misconception: 每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量~Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
units.practice: 設第二個相同脈衝在一小時後到達，安排中間假想出流大於入流的時段，計算恢復所需時間並說明若恢復不足會如何累積庫水。~Place a second identical pulse one hour later and specify an intervening period with outlet greater than inlet. Calculate recovery time and show how incomplete recovery accumulates water over repeated cycles.
